learning_outcomes.text: Practically learns surface conditions and tolerances.
Can draw screwed, bolted, studded, and nutted connections.
Practically learns keys, pins, dowel pins, clamping sleeves, cotter pins, circlips, and adjusting rings.
Possesses sufficient knowledge about rivets and welds.
Learns detailed information about complete drawings, assembly drawings and can make applications.
Can carry out original work in research, development, design, and manufacturing stages, understands and solves a given engineering problem, and learns to do machine design.

assessment_rules: The overall assessment includes 10% for opinion and 90% for homework. Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan; they are conducted on dates specified in the academic calendar by the University Senate decision.
